**Do you want to join a Content and Editorial team that's striving to provide inspirational experiences for kids across our owned platforms (apps, web, magazine)?**

We are looking for someone who’s had exposure to digital content, Magazine content and copywriting with a proactive mindset that has attention to detail and a creative and collaborative attitude.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Content management including but not limited to, content planning, content publishing and driving quality assurance of live content
* Keeping a close eye on the community in the LEGO Life app and reporting on content performance and trends
* Proofing of our LEGO Life magazine and handling of UGC submissions
* Creating adhoc content or copy where needed
* Bringing enthusiasm and ideas to creative brainstorms
* Staying up to date with landscape trends and insights from our competitors to inspire the team with new ideas for content, games and events – especially for the 8-12 year old audience

**Play your part in our team succeeding**

The Content & Editorial team within Digital Consumer Engagement is responsible for strategizing and producing content for our owned channels that are built in-house. These platforms allow The LEGO Group to offer inspirational, personal and social experiences to kids and adults across all touch points. This includes the LEGO® Life app and magazine, LEGO.com/kids, LEGO.com as well as several new innovative platforms currently under construction. Our team tries to bridge the gap between our software engineering and UX design teams creating these platforms on the one side and the product teams creating marketing campaigns for our franchises on the other. Together we create campaign and engagement content for our Digital Ecosystem that ties together all digital LEGO experiences in meaningful ways, creating deeper consumer engagement and improved consumer life-time value.

**Do you have what it takes?**

* Student at Bachelor or Master level
* Degrees in the fields of Digital Design, Communication, Marketing will be beneficial
* Has an interest in LEGO, digital platforms, the latest digital trends and content management
* Wants to work in a fast-paced agile environment
* Has attention to detail and a systematic approach to challenges
* Eager to learn and be part of a global team
* An ambitious self-starter who will take initiative
* Has experience in communication or digital design (this is a plus, though not mandatory)
* English at fluent level is required as this is the standard office language. Other languages are a positive plus.

## Nice to have

* Thrives and contributes in a team setting
* Previous experience working with content management systems (CMS) or on social media, gaming or other online platforms – both professionally or in their spare time.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

**What’s in it for you?**

Here is what you can expect:

**Family Care Leave** - We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times.

**Insurances** – All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind.

**Wellbeing** - We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity.

**Colleague Discount** – We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount.

**Bonus** - We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme.

**Workplace** - When you join the team you'll be assigned a primary workplace location i.e. one of our Offices, stores or factories. Our hybrid work policy means an average of 3 days per week in the office. The hiring team will discuss the policy and role eligibility with you during the recruitment process.

Children are our role models. Their curiosity, creativity and imagination inspire everything we do. We strive to create a diverse, dynamic and inclusive culture of play at the LEGO Group, where everyone feels safe, valued and they belong.

The LEGO Group is highly committed to equal employment opportunity and equal pay and seeks to encourage applicants from all backgrounds (eg. sex, gender identity or expression, race/ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, age and religion) to apply for roles in our team.

The LEGO Group is fully committed to Children’s Rights and Child Wellbeing across the globe. Candidates offered positions with high engagement with children are required to take part in Child Safeguarding Background Screening, as a condition of the offer.

Thank you for sharing our global commitment to Children’s Rights.

Just imagine building your dream career.

Then make it real.

**Join the LEGO® team today.**

jobs.title: Student Assistant, Netcompany IT Security
jobs.description_md:
*Do you find Threat Hunting, Threat Intelligence, SIEM and EDR exciting, and do you want to be a deciding factor in IT Security in our internal as well as our customer’s environments? As a Student Assistant you ensure operations can perform their security-related tasks based on guidelines you help define.*

**Tasks and Technologies**

As a Student Assistant you will be a part of Netcompany Operations and our dedicated security team consisting of skilled and committed colleagues. You will take part in defining how Denmark’s most ambitious IT company host solutions for critical Danish infrastructure and large international customers. You will encounter everything from identifying improvements to monitoring of servers and applications, optimising detection mechanisms and response thereof, advising colleagues about alerts as well as adjusting security tools.

You will be a trusted advisor for Netcompany’s delivery and project teams regarding how to solve security-related tasks.

Your responsibilities will typically include:

* Investigating patterns and implementing alerts and visualisations in our SIEM to ensure detection of suspicious events.
* Responding to and follow up on alerts generated by our SIEM and EDR solutions, including adjusting these to ensure precision.
* Configuring integrations between our SIEM and other systems and environments, including Cloud and containers.
* Configuring and monitoring our IDS/IPS solutions.

**About you**

We are looking for a student who can work approximately 16 hours per week. We are flexible during exam periods, but availability is expected in the lead-up to project deadlines and other key milestones. To succeed in this role, you:

* Are in the final year of your bachelor’s degree or have started a master’s degree in engineering, computer science, software, IT, or a similar field.
* Have experience with both Windows and Linux and have knowledge with SIEM or EDR solutions.
* Are highly motivated and eager to develop your skills
* Have full professional proficiency in Danish or English (written and spoken) is a must.

*It is a requirement for the position that you can be approved for PET security clearance.*

**Continue developing with us**
At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We support you in your development and in reaching your goals. You will be included in projects equally with your colleagues and have the chance to take on responsibility from day one.

We offer a strong collegial community where you will work closely with your team who supports you both in task completion and in your development in the role. The close relationship with your colleagues and leader in everyday work helps to ensure the well-being of each employee and gives you concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

**Join an inclusive community**
At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world.

We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

**Send us your application**
Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

*All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.*

*We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our responsible recruiters at* [*reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com*](mailto:reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com) *for assistance. #LI-SA1*

jobs.title: Bliv revisor graduate i 2027 hos Deloitte København
jobs.description_md:
Deloitte er Danmarks førende rådgivnings- og revisionshus. Vores revisionsforretning, Audit & Assurance, består af 750 medarbejdere fordelt på to kontorer i Danmark. Hos os kan du skræddersy din udvikling inden for utallige fagområder, roller, kundetyper og opgaver. Stillingen giver dig mulighed for at kombinere et fuldtidsarbejde inden for økonomi, rådgivning og den nyeste teknologi med uddannelse og personlig udvikling.

**Vil du starte din revisionskarriere på Deloittes hovedkontor?**

På vores kontor i København sidder vi 600 medarbejdere i Audit og Assurance på tværs af afdelinger og industrier, men til dagligt arbejder vi i mindre teams, så du får en tæt relation til dine kolleger. Vi har et godt sammenhold, udvikling på tværs og masser af fælles arrangementer fra fredagsbar til kurser. Så du får rig mulighed for at skabe et godt netværk og et stærkt fundament for, hvor din karriere i Deloitte skal bevæge sig hen.

Som revisorgraduate, vil din hverdag enten foregå i vores Portfolio- eller Large & Complex-afdeling. Her vil du blive tilknyttet ét af vores fire kundesegmenter: Public, Private, Financial Services eller Top Tier. Du vil få en fast afdelingsleder samt en coach, som du kan bruge til støtte i din personlige og professionelle udvikling.

Det er altså rimelig sikkert, at du hurtigt vil blive en del af dit nye fællesskab og får rig mulighed for at skabe nye relationer.

**I rollen som revisorgraduate vil du bl.a.**:

* Altid arbejde i kundeteams og være i tæt kontakt med både kolleger og kunder – ofte foregår arbejdet ude hos kunden.
* Tilegne dig stor viden om din afdelings kunder – og ikke mindst dygtiggøre dig i at rådgive og revidere dem.
* Deltage i planlægningen af revisioner, koordinere indsatser med fx Deloitte service- og delivery centre, som løser mange af vores administrative opgaver forud for statussæsonen.
* Bidrage til at udføre risikovurderinger af regnskabsområder, hvor du sætter din viden om kundens interne processer i spil.
* Udføre status sammen med et erfarent revisionsteam, som sikrer, at årsregnskabet giver et retvisende billede.

Dine opgaver vil selvfølgelig variere alt efter i hvilken afdeling, du får din daglige gang. Men vi lover dig, at dagene ikke bliver ensformige. Der vil være plads til at lære, spørge om hjælp og ikke mindst vokse og tage det ansvar, som du har lyst til.

**NEXT - vores udviklingsprogram for revisorgraduates**

Som revisorgraduate, starter du i en fuldtidsstilling og bliver tilknyttet vores interne udviklingsprogram NEXT sammen med ca. 100 andre nye graduates landet over, som løbende samles til undervisning og klædes på til nye opgaver.

Alt efter hvor du er i din uddannelse, når du starter hos os, vil du også følge et deltidsstudie på universitetet ved siden af. Du vil blive tilknyttet en buddy de første 100 dage du er hos os, som selv har prøvet at være ny trainee eller graduate, og som skal hjælpe dig godt ombord i din nye rolle.

Vi forestiller os, at du læser en HA-bachelor, cand.merc.aud eller en anden finansiel uddannelse. Vi er altid åbne for interessante indgangsveje, og for at du kan færdiggøre et uddannelsesniveau, mens du er hos os. Det vigtigste er, at du kommer med en oprigtig interesse i revision samt en motivation for at lære. Og så er det vigtigt, at du:

* Vil udvikle dig personligt.
* Er nysgerrig på det faglige revisionsarbejde.
* Besidder sociale evner, der understøtter dine fremtidige kunderelationer og i samarbejdet med dine kolleger.
* Har gjort dig relevante erfaringer enten professionelt eller i din fritid, hvor du har udmærket dig.
* Du kan forstå og tale engelsk og dansk.
* Du har arbejdstilladelse i Danmark.

Hos Deloitte værdsætter vi forskellige kompetencer, perspektiver og erfaringer, da det gør os i stand til effektivt at løse komplekse udfordringer for vores klienter. Vi opfordrer dig til at søge stillingen, hvis du mener, at dine kompetencer kan bidrage til vores teams succes.

Selv hvis du ikke umiddelbart genkender dig selv i alle de beskrevne kvalifikationer, ønsker vi stadig at opfordre dig til at søgestillingen, hvis du mener, at dine kompetencer kan bidrage positivt til vores team.

**Klik på ”jeg er interesseret” ovenfor for at søge stillingen.**

 Vi vil gerne se dit CV og karakterer fra din nuværende og forrige uddannelse, derudover beder vi dig i ansøgningsprocessen om at besvare et par spørgsmål. Derfor bedes du undlade at uploade en traditionel motiveret ansøgning.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og **forventer opstart 10.09.2027.**

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller ansættelsesprocessen, så kontakt venligst Recruitment Coordinator Emil Morelli Nørgaard på mobil: +45 53793260 eller mail [talent@deloitte.dk](mailto:talent@deloitte.dk?subject=Sp%C3%B8rgsm%C3%A5l%20til%20stillingen%20som%20revisorgraduate%202025)

Vi opfordrer alle kandidater til at søge stillingen, uanset alder, køn (kønsidentitet eller kønsudtryk), seksuel orientering, religion, etnicitet, nationalitet eller handicap.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

*In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.*

jobs.title: Student Assistant - GEM Cell Hub
jobs.location: Måløv, Capital Region of Denmark, DK
jobs.description_md:
**Job Title:** Student Assistant – GEM Cell Hub

**Department:** GEM Cell Hub (Genome Engineering & Manufacturing of Stem Cell-Derived Cell Types), Therapeutics Discovery, Research & Development

**Location:** Måløv, Denmark

**Your impact begins here**

As Student Assistant in the GEM Cell Hub, you will help keep our stem cell laboratories running smoothly, so scientists and laboratory technicians can focus on experimental work. You will make sure reagents, consumables and workspaces are ready, support routine sample preparation and, after training, help maintain human pluripotent stem cells (hPSCs) and ongoing cell differentiations. Your reliable day-to-day support helps the team deliver high-quality stem cell-derived cells for drug discovery.

**What you’ll bring**

You enjoy contributing to a well-organised laboratory and understand why reliable day-to-day support matters for research. You take initiative, ask questions when needed, and approach both routine and new tasks with care and curiosity. You will also bring:

* Enrolment in a relevant study programme, such as biotechnology, biology, biomedicine or a related field.
* An interest in laboratory work and a willingness to learn new techniques and procedures.
* A structured, reliable and detail-oriented approach, with the ability to organise and follow through on practical tasks.
* Good collaboration and communication skills, and comfort communicating in English and working as part of a team.
* Availability for agreed weekend work to support cell culture maintenance.

**Useful, but not essential:**

* Previous hands-on laboratory experience.
* Experience with cell culture, particularly aseptic techniques or the maintenance of mammalian cell types such as hPSCs.

**What you’ll do**

Your main focus will be the day-to-day operation of our laboratories, making sure everything is ready for experimental work. You will:

* Restock laboratory consumables and monitor stock levels, so essential supplies are always available.
* Help order reagents and consumables, receive deliveries and organise laboratory storage.
* Keep laboratories clean, organised and well-functioning, including routine upkeep of shared workspaces and equipment.
* Assist scientists and laboratory technicians with routine sample preparation and other practical laboratory tasks, following established protocols.
* Support routine cell culture tasks after appropriate training, including weekend maintenance of hPSCs and ongoing cell differentiations, with tasks and scheduling agreed with the team.
* Keep accurate records of your assigned laboratory tasks and follow relevant safety procedures.

**Who you’ll work with**

You will join the GEM Cell Hub in Therapeutics Discovery, part of Research & Development, where colleagues explore scientific ideas and advance them towards clinical testing. The hub supports drug discovery by generating stem cell-derived cell types for target discovery, screening assay development and drug screening.

The team provides high-quality stem cell-derived cells for a range of research applications, while continuously developing methods and processes to meet different requirements for cell types, quality and quantities. Working closely with colleagues across stem cell biology, cultivation technology and assay development, the team makes these cells accessible to researchers across Novo.

Day to day, you will work closely with scientists and laboratory technicians in Måløv, contributing to the laboratory operations that make this work possible.

**What you can expect here**

You will gain hands-on experience in a research laboratory and practical insight into stem cell research in a collaborative research setting. You will receive training before taking on cell culture tasks, and you will be encouraged to ask questions, learn new techniques and grow alongside experienced colleagues in a dynamic research environment.

**Salary and Benefits**: This position is hourly paid. For this position, the hourly base rate is 209,27 DKK**,** based on an assessment of relevant factors such as experience, educational background, demonstrated competencies, and the specific skills required for the position. In addition to the hourly base rate, Student Assistants are entitled to a pension scheme (currently 10% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution).

**Start now**

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to gain hands-on laboratory experience and help our stem cell research move forward, apply for the Student Assistant – GEM Cell Hub role by **20 October 2026.**

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.title: Studentermedhjælper til CRM, Marketing Automation og Kundedialog
jobs.description_md:

Karrieremuligheder: Studentermedhjælper til CRM, Marketing Automation og Kundedialog (15622)
Rekvisitions-id 15622 - Publiceret 29/09/2026 - København - Marketing
  Vis udskrift for jobbeskrivelse
Ansøg
 
Gem job
 
Send e-mail med job til en ven
 
Tilbage til listen


 

"Vi har et spændende studiejob til dig, der vil lære en masse om CRM, marketing automation, kundedata og digital kundedialog. Oveni hatten får du et fantastisk team med et godt fællesskab og mange muligheder for at arbejde på tværs af PFA," siger Anders Drost-Niemann, leder for Kundedialog i PFA. 

 

Så hvad er det egentlig, du skal?

Som studentermedhjælper i Kundedialog bliver du en del af arbejdet med at udvikle, udsende og optimere målrettet kundekommunikation via blandt andet e-mail, SMS, app-push og e-Boks. Du får direkte erfaring med CRM, marketing automation, kundedata, målgrupper og automatiserede kommunikationsflows.

 

Du bliver en del af et af Danmarks største marketing automation-setups, hvor vi hvert år sender millioner af kundekommunikationer til vores 1,3 millioner kunder via Adobe Campaign V8 og en række digitale kanaler. Sammen med teamets specialister bidrager du til drift, udvikling, effektmåling og optimering af PFA’s kundedialog.

Du skal forvente at arbejde +20 timer om ugen, og vi tilpasser arbejdstiden, så den passer med dit studie.

 

Du er nysgerrig på data, systemer og kundeadfærd

Dine nøgleopgaver bliver at:

bidrage til planlægning, opsætning og udsendelse af kundekommunikation via vores marketing automation-platform
arbejde med målgrupper, segmentering og kvalitetssikring af data
følge op på kampagner og kommunikationer gennem effektmåling, rapportering og analyse
bidrage til test, kvalitetssikring og løbende optimering af kommunikation og flows
understøtte teamets øvrige aktiviteter og projekter inden for CRM, Marketing Automation og Kundedialog

 

Hvem er du?

Du har et par år tilbage på fx CBS, EK, ITU eller lignende uddannelse
Du har interesse for CRM, marketing automation og datadrevet kundekommunikation
Du evner at sammenkoble data, budskaber og målgrupper
Du arbejder godt med systemer og trives med at arbejde i digitale platforme
Du føler dig hjemme i Office-pakken, særligt Excel
Du arbejder struktureret og har fokus på detaljer
Du vil trives som en del af et team og synes, det lyder spændende at arbejde på tværs af PFA

 

Din nye hverdag i PFA

I Kundedialog er vi ti kolleger, der ser frem til at møde dig. Teamet spænder bredt med kompetencer inden for CRM, Marketing Automation, MarTech og kundedata. Sammen arbejder vi med at udvikle og optimere den datadrevne kundedialog, som hver dag hjælper kunder med at få mest muligt ud af deres ordning hos PFA. 

Stemningen i teamet er uformel. Vi hjælper hinanden, sparrer åbent og har tillid til hinanden, så der er plads til både spørgsmål, idéer og ærlige holdninger.

I dagligdagen samarbejder vi tæt på kryds og tværs. Vi har et tæt og velfungerende kollegialt fællesskab, hvor der er plads til både samarbejde og sociale relationer

 

Hvad er det helt særlige, vi kan i PFA?   

I PFA er hverdagen noget, vi glæder os til. Du bliver en del af et inkluderende fællesskab og har mulighed for at deltage i en bred vifte af aktiviteter – fra boksning og løbeklub til fredagscaféer. På tværs af PFA er der mere end 60 studentermedhjælpere, og gennem foreningen PFA Students får du gode muligheder for både faglig og social sparring samt deltagelse i forskellige events. Du kan se frem til gode arbejdsforhold, fx byder køkkenet på frokost til alle kostpræferencer, og du kan købe take away med hjem. Vi er placeret i PFA’s nyrenoverede lokaler i Nordhavn i København, hvor du har let adgang til både Metro og S-tog.

 

Lyder det som noget for dig?  

Du behøver ikke at skrive en lang ansøgning. Vedhæft blot dit CV og tilføj et par linjer i dit resumé om, hvorfor du er interesseret i jobbet inden deadline d. 15. oktober 2026. Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Anders Drost-Niemann, leder for Kundedialog i PFA, på +45 24 75 63 23 eller ADN@pfa.dk.

Du føler dig hjemme i Office-pakken, særligt Excel

I Kundedialog er vi ti kolleger, der ser frem til at møde dig. Teamet spænder bredt med kompetencer inden for CRM, Marketing Automation, MarTech og kundedata. I dagligdagen samarbejder vi tæt på kryds og tværs. Vi har et tæt og velfungerende kollegialt fællesskab, hvor der er plads til både samarbejde og sociale relationer

På tværs af PFA er der mere end 60 studentermedhjælpere, og gennem foreningen PFA Students får du gode muligheder for både faglig og social sparring samt deltagelse i forskellige events. Du kan se frem til gode arbejdsforhold, fx byder køkkenet på frokost til alle kostpræferencer, og du kan købe take away med hjem. Vi er placeret i PFA’s nyrenoverede lokaler i Nordhavn i København, hvor du har let adgang til både Metro og S-tog.

 

Lyder det som noget for dig?  

Du behøver ikke at skrive en lang ansøgning. Vedhæft blot dit CV og tilføj et par linjer i dit resumé om, hvorfor du er interesseret i jobbet inden deadline d. 15. oktober 2026. Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Anders Drost-Niemann, leder for Kundedialog i PFA, på +45 24 75 63 23 eller ADN@pfa.dk.

Lyder det som noget for dig?  

Du behøver ikke at skrive en lang ansøgning. Vedhæft blot dit CV og tilføj et par linjer i dit resumé om, hvorfor du er interesseret i jobbet inden deadline d. 15. oktober 2026. Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Anders Drost-Niemann, leder for Kundedialog i PFA, på +45 24 75 63 23 eller ADN@pfa.dk.

jobs.title: Student Assistant, AI & Digital Acceleration, Novonesis
jobs.description_md:
**Interesseret i en karriere, der gør en forskel?**




Are you curious about Artificial Intelligence, digital transformation, and how technology can create business value?

At Novonesis, we are looking for a Student Assistant to join our Digital & AI Acceleration team within Food & Beverages Biosolutions (FBB). Working closely with leaders driving the AI and Digital agenda, you will help accelerate AI adoption, support digital transformation initiatives, and contribute to AI-powered solutions that create business impact. This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience at the intersection of technology, innovation, and business in a global organization.

**The role & your impact**

As a Student Assistant, you will support AI adoption, digital transformation, and AI solution development across FBB. You will contribute to both strategic initiatives and day-to-day execution, helping turn ideas into measurable business outcomes.

**Your key responsibilities in this role**

* Support AI and digital adoption activities across the organization.
* Create communication, training, and enablement materials.
* Support workshops, learning activities, and best-practice sharing.
* Contribute to the development, testing, and improvement of AI and digital solutions.
* Assist with stakeholder communication, meeting preparation, reporting, and progress tracking.
* Support data collection, dashboards, documentation, and operational activities.

**What you'll need to be successful in this role**

* Currently pursuing a Master's degree within business, technology, engineering, data science, biotechnology, life sciences, innovation, digital transformation, or a related field.
* Preferably at least 1.5 years remaining before completing your studies.
* Strong interest in AI, digital technologies, and business transformation.
* Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken.
* Structured, proactive, and detail-oriented approach to work.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Comfortable working with data and technology, including analyzing information, identifying insights, and exploring digital, AI, or low-code/no-code solutions to solve business challenges.

**Additional skills & interests we value**

* Experience with Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Microsoft Copilot, or similar technologies.
* Experience with coding, data science, data engineering, AI solution development, or related technical disciplines is considered an advantage.
* Experience creating presentations, training content, or communication materials.
* Interest in change management and technology adoption.

**What we offer you**

At Novonesis, you will join a collaborative and purpose-driven environment where learning and development are part of everyday work. You will work closely with leaders driving the AI and Digital agenda within FBB and gain hands-on experience with Generative AI, Microsoft Copilot, AI Agents, and digital solutions. The role offers a unique opportunity to build skills within AI adoption, project management, change management, and business transformation while collaborating with stakeholders across a global organization.

**Working conditions**

The position is based in Lyngby and Hørsholm, Denmark. The expected workload is approximately 10-15 hours per week, with flexibility around exam periods and study commitments. Regular presence in either office is expected, combined with the opportunity to work from home as agreed with the team. The role is ideal for someone who thrives in a dynamic international environment, enjoys learning new things, and takes a hands-on approach to getting things done.

**Application deadline:** 18 October 2026

**Location:** Lyngby/Hørsholm, Denmark

**Contact information: Yushu Shen Drehn,** Digital & AI Strategy Lead - [YSE@novonesis.com](mailto:YSE@novonesis.com)

**Vores formål viser vejen**

I Novonesis ved vi, at løsninger forankret i biologi kan hjælpe med at løse verdens største udfordringer. Siden vi begyndte for mere end et århundrede siden, har dette været vores pejlemærke. Det er sådan, vi er nået så langt. Og det er sådan, vi vil påvirke fremtiden. Nu, mere end nogensinde, har verden brug for forandring. Og med biosolutions er mulighederne for transformation uendelige. Hvis vores formål giver mening for dig, opfordrer vi dig til at søge.

**Muligheder for alle**

Vi er dedikerede til en inkluderende rekrutteringsproces og lige muligheder for alle ansøgere. Derfor beder vi dig om ikke at vedhæfte en ansøgning eller et foto og i stedet inkludere et par sætninger i dit CV, hvor du forklarer din motivation for at ansøge.

Vi træffer alle ansættelsesbeslutninger baseret på forretningsbehov og byder kandidater med en bred vifte af baggrunde velkommen, herunder etnicitet, religion, køn, seksuel orientering, alder, handicap eller veteranstatus.

**Udforsk andre stillinger**

Hvis denne stilling ikke passer til dig, kan du stadig finde andre muligheder hos os. Du er velkommen til at udforske ledige stillinger eller oprette en jobagent for at holde dig opdateret om fremtidige muligheder på [novonesis.com/Career](http://novonesis.com/Career).

jobs.location: Hillerød, Capital Region of Denmark, DK
jobs.description_md:
# **Student - Computerised Laboratory Systems**

**Sourcing LABS IT**

**Enterprise Platforms****Enterprise IT and Quality****Hillerød, Denmark**

Want to see how technology supports life-changing research and laboratory operations? In this role, you'll help improve processes, support digital solutions, and contribute to projects that make everyday work more efficient. Working alongside experienced professionals, you'll gain valuable insight into IT, compliance, and laboratory environments while developing skills for your future career.

Duration: 6-12 months

Working hours: Up to 8 hours per week

Apply now and start building experience that matters.

## **Your new role**

In this role, you'll gain hands-on experience at the intersection of IT, laboratory operations, and compliance. You'll support the systems and processes that laboratories rely on every day while contributing to projects that improve efficiency, collaboration, and ways of working.

Your main responsibilities will be:

* Supporting compliance and documentation activities related to computerised laboratory systems
* Contributing to projects and continuous improvement initiatives across the team
* Maintaining and enhancing internal websites and SharePoint solutions
* Supporting communication and information management activities
* Identifying opportunities to streamline processes and improve ways of working
* Taking ownership of a smaller project and driving it from idea to implementation

The exact scope of your work will be shaped by your interests, strengths, and development goals, as well as the team's priorities. From day one, you'll contribute to meaningful work, collaborate with a diverse range of stakeholders, and develop valuable experience across IT, compliance, and project management.

## **Your new department**

You'll join the Computerised Laboratory Systems team, where we deliver, qualify, support, and continuously improve the digital solutions used across our laboratories. Our work enables laboratory teams to operate efficiently, securely, and in compliance with applicable requirements.

Working closely with experienced colleagues, you'll gain exposure to the intersection of IT, laboratory operations, and compliance. You'll contribute to a variety of initiatives while collaborating with stakeholders across the organisation and learning how technology supports critical business processes every day.

**Your skills and qualifications**

We're looking for a curious and motivated student who enjoys learning, solving problems, and working with both people and technology. You don't need prior professional experience, but you should be excited about digital solutions and eager to make a meaningful contribution while developing new skills.

You may be studying IT, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Life Sciences, or a related field. We would be particularly interested in candidates who:

* Are structured, reliable, and comfortable taking ownership of their work
* Enjoy solving practical challenges and identifying opportunities for improvement
* Have an interest in digital solutions, IT systems, and process improvement
* Are interested in SharePoint or other collaboration and information management tools
* Communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing
* Bring curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to learn and grow

## **Working at Novo Nordisk**

Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.

## **What we offer**

At Novo Nordisk, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

**Salary and Benefits**: This position is hourly paid. For this position, the hourly base rate is 178,71 DKK, based on an assessment of relevant factors such as experience, educational background, demonstrated competencies, and the specific skills required for the position. In addition to the hourly base rate, Student Assistants are entitled to a pension scheme (currently 10% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution). ​

## **Contact**

For further information about the position, please contact please contact Mads Rudolph Raben at XDRB@novonordisk.com. Please be advised Mads will not support queries about your recruitment status.

##

##

## **Deadline**

October 18th, 2026

"Vi har et spændende studiejob til dig, der vil lære en masse om CRM, marketing automation, kundedata og digital kundedialog. Oveni hatten får du et fantastisk team med et godt fællesskab og mange muligheder for at arbejde på tværs af PFA," siger Anders Drost-Niemann, leder for Kundedialog i PFA. 

 

Så hvad er det egentlig, du skal?

Som studentermedhjælper i Kundedialog bliver du en del af arbejdet med at udvikle, udsende og optimere målrettet kundekommunikation via blandt andet e-mail, SMS, app-push og e-Boks. Du får direkte erfaring med CRM, marketing automation, kundedata, målgrupper og automatiserede kommunikationsflows.

 

Du bliver en del af et af Danmarks største marketing automation-setups, hvor vi hvert år sender millioner af kundekommunikationer til vores 1,3 millioner kunder via Adobe Campaign V8 og en række digitale kanaler. Sammen med teamets specialister bidrager du til drift, udvikling, effektmåling og optimering af PFA’s kundedialog.

Du skal forvente at arbejde +20 timer om ugen, og vi tilpasser arbejdstiden, så den passer med dit studie.

 

Du er nysgerrig på data, systemer og kundeadfærd

Dine nøgleopgaver bliver at:

bidrage til planlægning, opsætning og udsendelse af kundekommunikation via vores marketing automation-platform
arbejde med målgrupper, segmentering og kvalitetssikring af data
følge op på kampagner og kommunikationer gennem effektmåling, rapportering og analyse
bidrage til test, kvalitetssikring og løbende optimering af kommunikation og flows
understøtte teamets øvrige aktiviteter og projekter inden for CRM, Marketing Automation og Kundedialog

 

Hvem er du?

Du har et par år tilbage på fx CBS, EK, ITU eller lignende uddannelse
Du har interesse for CRM, marketing automation og datadrevet kundekommunikation
Du evner at sammenkoble data, budskaber og målgrupper
Du arbejder godt med systemer og trives med at arbejde i digitale platforme
Du føler dig hjemme i Office-pakken, særligt Excel
Du arbejder struktureret og har fokus på detaljer
Du vil trives som en del af et team og synes, det lyder spændende at arbejde på tværs af PFA

 

Din nye hverdag i PFA

I Kundedialog er vi ti kolleger, der ser frem til at møde dig. Teamet spænder bredt med kompetencer inden for CRM, Marketing Automation, MarTech og kundedata. Sammen arbejder vi med at udvikle og optimere den datadrevne kundedialog, som hver dag hjælper kunder med at få mest muligt ud af deres ordning hos PFA. 

Stemningen i teamet er uformel. Vi hjælper hinanden, sparrer åbent og har tillid til hinanden, så der er plads til både spørgsmål, idéer og ærlige holdninger.

I dagligdagen samarbejder vi tæt på kryds og tværs. Vi har et tæt og velfungerende kollegialt fællesskab, hvor der er plads til både samarbejde og sociale relationer

 

Hvad er det helt særlige, vi kan i PFA?   

I PFA er hverdagen noget, vi glæder os til. Du bliver en del af et inkluderende fællesskab og har mulighed for at deltage i en bred vifte af aktiviteter – fra boksning og løbeklub til fredagscaféer. Vi er placeret i PFA’s nyrenoverede lokaler i Nordhavn i København, hvor du har let adgang til både Metro og S-tog.

 

Lyder det som noget for dig?

jobs.title: Laboratory Technician, Bagsværd, Novonesis
jobs.description_md:
**Interesseret i en karriere, der gør en forskel?**




Are you passionate about laboratory science and excited by the opportunity to develop sustainable enzyme solutions used in detergents worldwide?

Join our Application Research team in Bagsværd, where you'll contribute to transforming advanced science into solutions that create value for customers and consumers while supporting a more sustainable future.

You will become part of a team of 6 Scientists and 13 Research Associates focused on developing enzyme solutions for detergents. Together, we plan and execute experiments, analyze complex data, and explore innovative ways to demonstrate the value of our technologies. We work in a collaborative and dynamic environment where curiosity, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement are key to our success.

**The role & your impact**

As a Laboratory Technician, you will play a key role in generating scientific insights that support research projects and innovation within detergent applications. Through practical laboratory work, digital tools, and data-driven decision-making, you will help advance enzyme technologies and contribute to developing solutions with global impact.

**Your key responsibilities in this role**

* Plan, execute, and conclude laboratory experiments independently and as part of project teams.
* Develop and implement scaled-down assays and analytical methods to support research activities.
* Analyze experimental data using statistical approaches and digital tools
* Collaborate closely with colleagues across research, technical support, and marketing functions.
* Contribute to the development of digital tools, automation capabilities, and efficient data management practices.
* Support a positive and high-performing work environment built on trust, collaboration, and mutual respect.

**What you'll need to be successful in this role**

* Laboratory Technician education or an equivalent scientific qualification is required.
* Experience working within applied research is advantageous.
* Experience with statistical data analysis, large datasets, and digital tools.
* Interest in digitalization, automation, and data management.
* Ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and spoken.
* Strong collaboration skills combined with the ability to work independently.
* A proactive mindset with the ability to take ownership of tasks and deliver results.
* Curiosity and a willingness to learn and contribute to continuous improvement.

**Additional skills & interests we value**

* Experience with JMP or similar statistical software.
* Knowledge of enzymes, proteins, or detergent applications.
* Previous experience developing analytical methods or laboratory assays.
* Interest in digital tools, automation, and innovative ways of working.
* Enjoyment of working across scientific disciplines and with a wide range of stakeholders.

**What we offer you**

At Novonesis, you'll join an innovative and dynamic research environment where science and technology are used to create positive impact for people and the planet. We offer varied and meaningful tasks, close collaboration with talented colleagues, and excellent opportunities for both professional and personal development.

You will gain valuable insight into detergent chemistry, enzyme functionality, statistical analysis, and digital technologies while contributing to projects that help shape future biosolutions.

**Working conditions**

This is a full-time position of 37.5 hours per week, working Monday to Friday during daytime hours. The role is primarily laboratory-based and located in Bagsværd. As part of your daily work, you will handle detergents, fragrances, and enzymes. Due to the nature of the materials used, the work environment may not be suitable for individuals with allergies to fragrances and/or enzymes.

**Application deadline:** 18 October 2026

**Contact Information:**

For questions regarding the position, please contact: Laboratory Manager Stephanie Reschka - strc@novonesis.com.

**Vores formål viser vejen**

I Novonesis ved vi, at løsninger forankret i biologi kan hjælpe med at løse verdens største udfordringer. Siden vi begyndte for mere end et århundrede siden, har dette været vores pejlemærke. Det er sådan, vi er nået så langt. Og det er sådan, vi vil påvirke fremtiden. Nu, mere end nogensinde, har verden brug for forandring. Og med biosolutions er mulighederne for transformation uendelige. Hvis vores formål giver mening for dig, opfordrer vi dig til at søge.

jobs.location: DR Byen P3 Podcast og Satire
jobs.description_md:
**Videostærk studentermedhjælper til P3 Podcast & Satire**

P3 Podcast & Satire søger en studentermedhjælper, der er skarp til video, sikker i Premiere Pro og har blik for, hvad der fungerer på sociale medier.

P3 Podcast & Satire er et kreativt redaktionsmiljø, der laver nogle af P3’s største podcasts som **Tyran, Under Radaren, Galt Nok, Hvem er…, KUP, Bare Os, Med al respekt og Elskovspony**. På samme redaktion laver vi også P3’s satire til Instagram.

Vi arbejder aktivt med at udvikle podcast som både lyd- og videoformat og udgiver indhold på blandt andet DR Lyd, Instagram, YouTube og Spotify.

##

## **Ansvar og arbejdsopgaver**

Din vigtigste opgave bliver at klippe videoindhold fra vores podcasts. Du skal kunne finde de stærkeste øjeblikke i længere optagelser og omsætte dem til reels og andet shortform-indhold, der fungerer i et feed.

Derudover får du ansvar for en række faste opgaver på redaktionen, blandt andet KODA-rapportering.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

* klippe reels og andet videoindhold fra vores podcasts i Adobe Premiere Pro
* finde stærke øjeblikke i længere podcastoptagelser
* tekste og tilpasse video til forskellige platforme
* arbejde med hooks, tempo og dramaturgi
* rapportere musik til KODA
* løse andre praktiske opgaver på redaktionen

Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med redaktører, producere, værter og resten af holdet på P3 Podcast & Satire.

## **Din profil**

Vi forestiller os, at du er i gang med en videregående uddannelse og har erfaring med videoredigering.

Det er vigtigt, at du er **godt hjemme i Adobe Premiere Pro**, kan arbejde selvstændigt og har blik for, hvad der fungerer på Instagram, TikTok og YouTube. Det er en fordel, hvis du interesserer dig for podcast, journalistik, humor og populærkultur.

Som person er du proaktiv og struktureret med et blik for det sjove og kreative. Du har både lyst til at arbejde kreativt med video og kan sørge for, at de administrative opgaver bliver løst ordentligt og til tiden.

##

## **Vi tilbyder**

Du bliver en del af P3 Podcast & Satire i DR Byen og kommer tæt på produktionen af nogle af P3’s største podcasts og en redaktion, der arbejder med både podcast, video og satire.

Du får mulighed for at udvikle dine evner inden for videoredigering, sociale medier og podcast og bliver en del af et miljø med højt tempo, mange forskellige fagligheder og kort vej fra idé til udgivelse.

Og sidst men ikke mindst, bliver du en del af et sjovt og ambitiøst fællesskab med fart på.

##

## **Kontakt**

DR ønsker at afspejle samfundet. Derfor opfordrer vi alle uanset køn, alder, religion, handicap og etnisk baggrund til at søge.

Du kommer til at arbejde i DR Byen, som har metro lige til døren.

Du er velkommen til at kontakte **Redaktionsleder for P3 Podcast & Satire, Anders Stegger** på aris@dr.dk, hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning, dit cv og relevante eksamenspapirer. **Send også meget gerne eksempler på videoindhold, du selv har klippet.**

Stillinger i DR søges udelukkende elektronisk. Du søger ved at klikke på ”Søg stillingen” i højre side.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 17. oktober 2026 kl. 12.

jobs.description_md:
**Job Description**

Would you like to help our team succeed in creating a robust and repeatable solvent welding process for ABS? 

Bring your curiosity for polymers, solvents and laboratory experimentation to help identify, test and optimize safe, repeatable and high-quality solvent welding solutions for ABS at the LEGO Group. 

**Core Responsibilities** 

* Help us research and screen candidate solvents and solvent blends for welding ABS, considering polymer interaction, evaporation rate and practical handling.

* Assist in planning and executing structured laboratory experiments to evaluate key solvent welding variables using Design of Experiments (DoE) principles where appropriate.

* Correlate bond performance with solvent choice and process conditions to help define a practical and repeatable process window.

* Link in with Product Safety (PS) and Environment, Health and Safety (EHS) departments.

* Document test methods, experimental results, conclusions and recommendations in a clear and structured way.

* Document and communicate theoretical chemical background behind empirical observations

**Play your part in our team succeeding** 

You will join R&D Processing in our brand-new engineering campus in Billund and contribute to a development project focused on solvent welding assembly of ABS parts. Working with experienced colleagues across Materials, Quality, Element Development, Product Safety and EHS.  

**Do you have what it takes?** 

* Currently studying Polymer Science, Materials Science, Materials Engineering, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering or a closely related field.

* Enrolled in a relevant bachelor or master programme with an interest in applying academic knowledge through laboratory-based development work.
* Basic understanding of polymer-solvent interactions and an interest in polymers, materials or joining processes.

* Hands-on interest in planning and carrying out laboratory experiments.

* Ability to analyse data and draw clear, evidence-based conclusions.

* Strong documentation skills and the ability to communicate methods, results and recommendations clearly.

* Structured, curious and able to work both independently and collaboratively.

**Nice to** **have**

* Awareness of laboratory safety, chemical handling and EHS considerations.

* Experience with microscopy, cross-section preparation or other materials characterization methods.

* Familiarity with mechanical testing methods for bonded or welded joints.

* Experience with Design of Experiments (DoE) or statistical analysis, including advanced or dynamic DoE approaches.

* Specific knowledge of ABS and solvent-based polymer joining.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Children are our role models. Their curiosity, creativity and imagination inspire everything we do. We strive to create a diverse, dynamic and inclusive culture of play at the LEGO Group, where everyone feels safe, valued and they belong.

The LEGO Group is highly committed to equal employment opportunity and equal pay and seeks to encourage applicants from all backgrounds (eg. sex, gender identity or expression, race/ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, age and religion) to apply for roles in our team.

The LEGO Group is fully committed to Children’s Rights and Child Wellbeing across the globe. Candidates offered positions with high engagement with children are required to take part in Child Safeguarding Background Screening, as a condition of the offer.

Support the exploration of additional AI and analytics use cases, such as supplier-capacity utilization, dispensation process, claims process, ECR process etc.

You will be part of a team that is strengthening its digital capabilities by exploring how AI can solve real business challenges and create tangible value. Working closely with colleagues across the department, you will combine your interest in AI and technology with your understanding of business processes to develop practical solutions.

We are looking for a curious and proactive student who is passionate about AI and eager to apply it in a real business environment. You will work at the intersection of technology and business, turning opportunities into solutions that improve efficiency, data quality and decision-making. As well as developing our first AI use case, you will have the opportunity to explore new opportunities and help shape how we use AI across the department.

* Currently studying Mechanical Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science or related field with a strong interest in applying technology to real business challenges
* Familiarity with Python, data analysis, and machine learning concepts
* Interest in computer vision, technical documentation understanding, OCR and multimodel AI
* Structured and critical approach to data quality, testing and validation
* Curious and analytical mindset, with the ability to understand complex problems, analyze data and turn business needs into practical digital solutions
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with business colleagues, understand their needs and translate technical possibilities into tangible business value.

* Microsoft Power Apps/Power Automate – experience building simple business applications and automating workflows
* Python – experience with data analysis, automation
* Danish is not mandatory. Fluent in English both written and oral is a must.

jobs.title: IT Service Desk Teamlead, Novonesis
jobs.description_md:
**Interesseret i en karriere, der gør en forskel?**




Are you an experienced people leader who is passionate about building high-performing IT support teams and delivering seamless digital experiences? At Novonesis, we are looking for a Team Lead to lead our Denmark-based ITSM ServiceDesk team and take full leadership responsibility for the people, performance, and day-to-day operation of Local IT support. 

In this role, you will be the leader of the Danish ServiceDesk team — setting direction and goals, developing your team, and owning the results your team delivers to employees across the organization. Working in a global ITSM environment, you will combine people leadership, operational management, and service excellence to ensure that the Service Desk consistently meets its targets and continuously raises the standard of IT support across Novonesis. 

 

**The Role & Your Impact** 

As Team Lead for the ITSM ServiceDesk in Denmark, you will lead a team of 12 ServiceDesk supporters plus a group of student assistants. You hold full personnel responsibility for the team and are accountable for both the wellbeing and the performance of your team. You set the goals, you build the team, and you own the outcomes. 

You are responsible for the full people-leadership cycle — from recruiting the right talent and onboarding new colleagues to coaching, developing, and following up on performance, so that every team member knows what is expected and has what they need to succeed. 

Beyond leading people, you own the operational delivery of the team: staffing and shift coverage, workload prioritization, escalation handling, and adherence to agreed service levels. You translate the Global ITSM strategy into clear team goals, track performance through ServiceNow analytics, and act on the data to keep improving. 

  

Your key leadership responsibilities include: 

* Lead, motivate, and develop a team of 12 ServiceDesk supporters and student assistants through regular one-to-ones, feedback, and structured development conversations.

* Set clear team and individual goals aligned to Global ITSM targets, and manage performance against defined KPIs such as SLA compliance, First Contact Resolution, CSAT, and escalation quality.

* Own workforce planning, recruitment, and onboarding to ensure the right capabilities and coverage on the team.

* Recognize and grow strong performers, and follow up constructively when performance or collaboration needs to improve.

* Manage rotations, shift coverage, and daily prioritization so the Service Desk consistently meets its service levels throughout the working day.

* Act as the escalation point for complex or sensitive cases, and safeguard the quality and consistency of the support your team delivers.

* Represent the Danish ServiceDesk toward Global IT, resolver groups, and business stakeholders, and coordinate closely with peer team leads across the global hubs.

* Use ServiceNow reporting to monitor trends, remove recurring issues, and drive service improvement within the team.

* Enable team members to take part in projects and in improving ways of working, balancing this with daily operational demands.

 

**What You'll Need to Be Successful** 

To succeed in this role, you bring proven people-leadership experience combined with a solid background in IT support and service management. 

We imagine that you have a degree, certification, or equivalent background within Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline, combined with experience from IT support, ServiceDesk operations, or similar customer-facing IT functions. As a minimum, we require 5 years of experience managing a team of at least 8 people. 

Just as important as your experience is how you lead. You have strong people skills and a high level of emotional intelligence: you build trust, read people and situations well, and adapt your leadership to the individual. You set clear expectations, handle difficult conversations with respect, and use service management data to steer your team and its results. 

 

In addition, you possess: 

* Strong people skills and a high level of emotional intelligence.

* Experience with recruitment, onboarding, coaching, and developing team members.

* Strong goal-setting and performance-management skills, with the ability to turn KPIs and analytics into action.

* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, and the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical audiences.

* A calm, fair, and solution-oriented leadership style, especially in high-pressure situations.

* Fluent Danish and English, both written and spoken.

* A strong sense of ownership and accountability for your team's performance and results.

 

**Additional Skills & Interests We Value** 

Experience leading teams in global organizations and complex enterprise environments would be an advantage, as would knowledge of ITIL principles and best practices and hands-on experience with ServiceNow. We also value experience with workforce planning, shift-based operations, and participation in service improvement, digital workplace, or IT transformation programs. 

Additional language skills and experience collaborating across cultures and time zones are also considered valuable. 

 

**What We Offer** 

At Novonesis, you will become part of a global IT organization that plays a critical role in enabling business performance and innovation. As Team Lead, you will have real ownership of your team and its results, with the mandate to shape how Local IT support is delivered in Denmark and the opportunity to influence the wider global ServiceDesk. 

We offer a collaborative and international work environment, leadership development opportunities, exposure to global IT initiatives, and the chance to build and grow a team that makes a difference for employees worldwide. You will join an organization that values people leadership, knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and a strong commitment to service excellence. 

 

**Ways of Working / Working Conditions** 

You will lead a Denmark-based team while working in a highly collaborative international environment, with close interaction across Global IT functions, peer team leads, and business stakeholders worldwide. The role combines hands-on team leadership with daily operational management and requires regular engagement with users and stakeholders across regions and organizational levels. As a people leader, you are responsible for the performance, development, and wellbeing of your team, and success requires a high degree of professionalism, fairness, and the ability to build trust with both your team and stakeholders across the organization.

**Location**: Hørsholm/Lyngby

jobs.title: Student Assistant, Netcompany Institute
jobs.description_md:
*How does Europe reap the benefits of AI, while remaining secure, sovereign and true to its democratic values? These are some of the questions that Netcompany Institute has set out to answer, and we are looking for two student assistants to help us do just that.*

*Netcompany Institute is a new analytical unit providing data-driven analyses of how AI and digitalization affect Europe. The aim is to strengthen the evidence base for public debate and help decision-makers navigate the choices that will shape Europe’s digital future.  You'll join a small team: a Chief Economist and two full-time Analytics Consultants.*

**Responsibilities**

You will support analyses throughout their lifecycle – from framing questions to communicating results. Your responsibilites will typically include:

* Monitor policy developments and research on AI and digitalisation in Europe
* Collect and structure data from Eurostat, OECD and statistical offices
* Produce descriptive statistics, tables and charts publication-ready
* Write analytical text and fact-check sources

Responsibility grows with experience. At the beginning you will work closely with an Analytics Consultant on clearly defined tasks; over time we expect you to take ownership of analyses in your own right.

**How we work with AI**

AI tools are integral to our work. We use them for literature searches, data work and monitoring – so human time focuses on what matters most: finding the right questions, interpreting results and communicating them clearly. You don't need expertise at the start, but must be willing to learn and maintain high accuracy standards.

**About you**

We are looking for two students who can each work approximately 16 hours per week. We are flexible during exam periods, but availability is expected in the lead-up to publication deadlines and events. To succeed in this role, you:

* Are in the final year of your bachelor’s degree or have started a master’s degree in economics, political science, statistics, data science or a similar field.
* Full professional proficiency in English (written and spoken) is a must; Danish is an advantage.
* Are comfortable working with data: confident in Excel and ideally familiar with Python, R, Stata or a similar tool.
* Are curious about how AI and digitalisation are changing European economies and societies
* Are willing to learn to use AI tools effectively in your own work, and to keep relating output critically to prior knowledge and theory.

**Continue developing with us**

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

**Join an inclusive community**

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

**Send us your application**

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

*All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.*

If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1*

The role offers hands-on experience in sustainability strategy implementation, energy management, carbon reporting, and renewable energy initiatives while supporting key business decisions and climate commitment.

* Support energy data analysis, forecasting, and consumption modelling to inform sustainability and operational decision-making.
* Perform calculations and business case assessments for energy efficiency and decarbonization projects, supporting investment approvals and savings reporting.
* Provide administrative support for project tracking, team activities, and follow-up actions.

* Develop data visualizations, dashboards, and management reporting in Excel and PowerPoint to support decision-making and strategic oversight.
* Create presentations, one-pagers, and storytelling materials to communicate sustainability initiatives and drive stakeholder engagement across functions.
* Document processes, governance structures, and methodologies for the climate and carbonworkstreams

## Play a part in our team succeeding

Sustainable Operations is the global department within LEGO Group that leads the change journey towards zero environmental impact in our factories. We lead, design and implement sustainable solutions primarily within energy/CO2, water, and waste - in a circular mindset. Moreover, we are responsible for managing the tracking of realized reductions towards zero-impact, and the programme office for sustainability in Engineering & Workplace. We identify and implement reduction projects in close collaboration with the production sites and other partners

*We take our part in a global force for good to reduce negative impact on the environment. Our part in this journey is to reduce energy consumption, remove CO2 emissions, eliminate waste, and reduce water consumption in our Operations in the LEGO Group.*

* Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Sustainability, Environmental Science, Business Analytics, Economics, Data Science, or a related field.
* Minimum two years remaining in studies before graduation.
* Strong analytical skills with experience in data analysis, forecasting, and modelling.
* Passion for sustainability, climate strategy, energy management, renewable energy, and decarbonization initiatives.
* Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint.
* Available to work approximately 15-20 hours per week during the semester.

jobs.title: Vil du være med til at lave økonomiske analyser, der flytter samfundet? Bliv student i DI
jobs.location: DI København - Industriens Hus H. C. Andersens Blvd. 18 1553 København Denmark DI København - Industriens Hus H. C. Andersens Blvd. 18 1553 København Denmark København
jobs.description_md:
**Om os**

I DI’s enhed for økonomisk politik og analyse følger vi på tætteste hold udviklingen i dansk og international økonomi og den økonomiske politik. Vores ambition er at være Danmarks førende videnscenter om virksomhederne og deres økonomiske situation. Tre gange om året udarbejder vi en prognose for dansk økonomi, og fire gange om året tager vi temperaturen på dansk erhvervsliv gennem en rundspørge til vores medlemmer i DI’s Virksomhedspanel.

Vi supplerer konjunkturovervågningen med analyser af blandt andet eksport, produktivitet, erhvervsstrukturer, offentlige finanser og investeringer. Alle analyser offentliggøres, indgår i den offentlige debat og understøtter DI’s politiske arbejde. Vi leverer også data, beregninger og analyser til resten af DI. F.eks. har vi udarbejdet en 2035-plan, der danner grundlag for DI’s politiske interessevaretagelse. Og vi står bag det analytiske fundament i DI’s undersøgelse af erhvervsvilkårene i kommunerne, Lokal Erhvervsvenlighed.

**Om jobbet**

Du bliver en del af en studentergruppe på fire studenter. Herudover består enheden af syv økonomer, en data scientist og en chef. Arbejdet giver dig rig mulighed for at få en praktisk vinkel på teorierne fra studiet. Du vil indgå i de faglige diskussioner med afdelingens økonomer og opnå en dybere forståelse af dansk og international økonomi samt aktuelle økonomisk-politiske problemstillinger.

Vi giver dig grundig oplæring og løbende faglig sparring. I takt med at du bliver fortrolig med opgaverne, får du ansvar for egne leverancer og mulighed for at skrive analyser, bidrage til præsentationer og holde oplæg i og uden for DI. Du vil også få en række løbende ad hoc-opgaver, der spænder fra overvågning af økonomiske nøgletal og arbejde med data, beregninger og bidrag til analyser. Vores vigtigste arbejdsredskaber er Excel, SAS, R og Python.

Arbejdstiden er som udgangspunkt omkring 15 timer om ugen. Vi tilrettelægger arbejdet fleksibelt og tager hensyn til undervisning og eksamener, herunder med mulighed for læsefri.

Vi sidder i et åbent kontormiljø i vores lokaler på Rådhuspladsen og har en uformel omgangstone, hvor dialog, udvikling og samarbejde er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Du bliver også en del af fællesskabet blandt studenter på tværs af DI’s politiske område og af det tværgående studenternetværk CAMP, som løbende arrangerer sociale aktiviteter.

**Om dig**

Du studerer økonomi og har et højt fagligt niveau, stærke analytiske evner og interesse for samfundsøkonomiske problemstillinger. Måske har du allerede kendskab til analyse eller programmering i f.eks. SAS, Python eller R fra studiet eller et andet job – ellers vil du gerne lære det.Du har lyst til at bruge din teoretiske viden til at arbejde med praktiske økonomiske analyser i en politisk organisation som DI.

**Interesseret?**

Hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen, kan du kontakte chefkonsulent Asger Bjerg Pedersen på tlf. 5218 5921.

Send dit CV og karakterudskrift via ansøgningslinket senest d. 11. oktober 2026. I stedet for at sende en traditionel ansøgning, vil vi bede dig svare på tre spørgsmål om din motivation og interesse for stillingen i ansøgningssystemet. Vi forventer at holde samtaler i uge 42 og 43.

jobs.title: Studentermedhjælper til Customer Service & Logistics
jobs.description_md:
**Interesseret i en karriere, der gør en forskel?**




Vil du være en vigtig del af den daglige drift i en global virksomhed og samtidig opbygge værdifuld erfaring inden for administration, logistik og kundeservice? I Customer Service & Logistics bliver du en del af en afdeling med omkring 40 kolleger, som hver dag sikrer, at kunder over hele verden modtager deres produkter korrekt og til tiden.

  

Som studentermedhjælper kommer du til at arbejde tæt sammen med to andre studentermedhjælpere og kolleger på tværs af afdelingen. Sammen understøtter i de administrative processer, der er afgørende for pålidelige leverancer og en stærk kundeoplevelse.

  

**Rollen & dit bidrag**Som studentermedhjælper får du en vigtig operativ rolle, hvor du understøtter Customer Service & Logistics med administrative opgaver, dokumenthåndtering og koordinering. Du bliver en del af et team med højt fokus på kvalitet, service og samarbejde.

  

**Dine primære ansvarsområder i denne rolle**

  

* Udarbejde eksportdokumenter samt opdatere og vedligeholde forskellige dokumenter.
* Håndtere og besvare generelle spørgsmål og opgaver fra interne interessenter via en fælles mailboks.
* Indkøbe mindre kontorudstyr via en online platform.
* Understøtte kolleger i Customer Service and Logistics med forskellige administrative ad hoc-opgaver.

  

**Hvad der skal til for, at du får succes i denne rolle**

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  

* Er i gang med første eller andet år af en bacheloruddannelse, gerne inden for logistik, Supply Chain Management eller en anden relevant uddannelse.
* Taler og skriver flydende dansk.
* Har gode engelskkundskaber, både skriftligt og mundtligt.
* Har erfaring med Microsoft Office-pakken, herunder Excel, Word og PowerPoint.
* Har evnen til hurtigt at sætte dig ind i nye administrative systemer og arbejdsprocesser.
* Er struktureret, detaljeorienteret, og kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine opgaver.
* Er god til at kommunikere og samarbejde med forskellige interessenter.
* Er resultatorienteret og kan håndtere flere opgaver og deadlines samtidigt.

  

**Andre færdigheder og interesser, som vi værdsætter**

Det er en fordel, men ikke et krav, hvis du:

  

* Har interesse for logistik, supply chain eller international handel.
* Har erfaring med Adobe-programmer.
* Har tidligere erfaring fra et administrativt studiejob.
* Trives med at identificere forbedringsmuligheder og tage initiativ til nye løsninger.

**Det, vi kan tilbyde dig**Du får mulighed for at opbygge relevant erhvervserfaring ved siden af studiet og opnå værdifuld indsigt i kundeservice, logistik og supply chain-processer. Samtidig bliver du en del af et engageret og samarbejdsorienteret arbejdsmiljø, hvor ansvar, tillid og faglig udvikling er centrale værdier, og hvor du arbejder tæt sammen med kolleger på tværs af organisationen.

  

**Arbejdsforhold**Stillingen er på gennemsnitligt 10-15 timer om ugen, primært inden for almindelig kontortid. Arbejdsstedet er i Bagsværd, hvor fysisk fremmøde på kontoret er en forudsætning, da hjemmearbejde ikke er muligt i rollen. Der forventes gensidig fleksibilitet i forhold til arbejdsbelastning, eksamensperioder og deadlines. Arbejdet består af kontorbaserede administrative opgaver uden væsentlige fysiske krav og foregår i et professionelt arbejdsmiljø i Customer Service & Logistics.

  

**Ansøgningsfrist:** 7. oktober 2026. Vi indkalder til samtaler efter ansøgningsfristens udløb, og du kan derfor forvente at høre mere fra os efter denne dato.

  

**Kontaktperson:** Head of Shipping and Solutions EMA Maja Kiel på [MJK@novozymes.com](mailto:MJK@novozymes.com).

**Vores formål viser vejen**

I Novonesis ved vi, at løsninger forankret i biologi kan hjælpe med at løse verdens største udfordringer. Siden vi begyndte for mere end et århundrede siden, har dette været vores pejlemærke. Det er sådan, vi er nået så langt. Og det er sådan, vi vil påvirke fremtiden. Nu, mere end nogensinde, har verden brug for forandring. Og med biosolutions er mulighederne for transformation uendelige. Hvis vores formål giver mening for dig, opfordrer vi dig til at søge.

**Muligheder for alle**

Vi er dedikerede til en inkluderende rekrutteringsproces og lige muligheder for alle ansøgere. Derfor beder vi dig om ikke at vedhæfte en ansøgning eller et foto og i stedet inkludere et par sætninger i dit CV, hvor du forklarer din motivation for at ansøge.

Vi træffer alle ansættelsesbeslutninger baseret på forretningsbehov og byder kandidater med en bred vifte af baggrunde velkommen, herunder etnicitet, religion, køn, seksuel orientering, alder, handicap eller veteranstatus.

**Udforsk andre stillinger**

Hvis denne stilling ikke passer til dig, kan du stadig finde andre muligheder hos os. Du er velkommen til at udforske ledige stillinger eller oprette en jobagent for at holde dig opdateret om fremtidige muligheder på [novonesis.com/Career](http://novonesis.com/Career).

* Assistance til events med praktiske opgaver før, under og efter afvikling

Du brænder for at skabe indhold på digitale platforme og kan lide at møde nye mennesker.  
Du arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og tager ansvar, samtidig med at du gerne bringer dine gode idéer i spil. Sprogligt er du stærk i både dansk og engelsk, så du kan skrive korte, præcise tekster og finde fængende overskrifter til artiklerne.

* Canva
