**Om os**  
DI e-commerce er et lille, dedikeret team, der sætter e-commerce på dagsordenen. Vi arbejder sammen med de fleste af DI’s branchefællesskaber og er i kontakt med mange forskellige virksomheder, der sælger digitalt. Vores kontor er i Industriens Hus ved Rådhuspladsen i København.

**Er du interesseret?**Ønsker du yderligere oplysninger om jobbet, kan du kontakte ansvarlig for e-commerce, Mie Bilberg, på 2119 3403. Send ansøgning og CV via ansøgningslinket senest den 11. oktober 2026. Vi afholder løbende samtaler, indtil vi har fundet den rette kandidat. Tiltrædelse snarest muligt.

jobs.title: Student Assistant for the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation Project
jobs.description_md:
**Interesseret i en karriere, der gør en forskel?**




Would you like to help drive one of the most significant packaging regulations in Europe while gaining hands-on experience in global program and project management?

  

Join the PPWR Team in Novonesis' Supply Chain organization and become part of a newly established team responsible for driving our global PPWR Program and supporting compliance with the EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation. This is a unique opportunity to join a team at the beginning of an important journey, helping Novonesis prepare for a more sustainable packaging future.

  

Today, we are five colleagues representing four nationalities, and we are growing as the program moves into execution. We combine a structured PMO setup and strong project management framework with an open, curious, and pragmatic way of working, creating an environment where learning and collaboration are at the heart of everything we do.

  

**The role & your impact**As a Student Assistant in the PPWR Team, you will provide dedicated support to the PMO Manager and contribute to creating structure, transparency, and progress across a global transformation program.

You will gain valuable insight into how large-scale programs are managed while supporting projects that span multiple functions, stakeholders, and geographies across Novonesis.

  

**In this role, you will make an impact by:**

  

* Collecting, consolidating, and following up on project status updates, milestones, risks, actions, and decisions across the program.
* Supporting financial tracking and reporting by gathering inputs, validating data quality, and preparing clear overviews for decision-making.
* Preparing steering committee presentations, agendas, meeting materials, and other decision-support documentation.
* Supporting program communication and helping ensure information is accurate, current, and accessible to stakeholders.
* Providing day-to-day PMO support, including meeting documentation, action follow-up, coordination of inputs, and stakeholder communication.

  

**What you will need to be successful**We imagine that you are currently enrolled in a relevant higher-education program and are looking to gain practical experience within program management, business operations, finance, or supply chain.

  

**To succeed in this role, you bring:**

  

* Enrollment in a relevant degree program such as business administration, economics, finance, supply chain management, project management, communication, or a related field.
* Strong analytical skills and an interest in understanding how projects, finances, compliance requirements, and business priorities connect.
* Experience working with data and the ability to organize information, identify inconsistencies, and create structured overviews.
* Good skills in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint and professional written and spoken English.

  

**We are looking for someone who:**

  

* Is structured, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously.
* Is proactive and able to work independently while knowing when to seek guidance and reliable and committed to delivering high-quality work with accuracy and attention to detail.

  

**While not required, it would be an advantage if you have:**

  

* Experience with Teams, SharePoint, or similar collaboration and documentation tools.
* An interest in project management, PMO processes, compliance, or supply chain operations.
* Experience supporting administrative, coordination, or back-office activities.
* An interest in working across functions and engaging with stakeholders from different parts of the organization.
* Curiosity about sustainability, packaging regulation, and business transformation initiatives.

  

**What we offer**You will become part of a purpose-driven company where biology powers solutions to some of the world's biggest challenges.

  

**In this role, you can expect:**

  

* A unique opportunity to join a newly established global program team and contribute to an important strategic initiative.
* Hands-on experience with PMO disciplines, program governance, project reporting, stakeholder management, and business communication.
* Close collaboration with experienced project and program professionals.
* Exposure to senior stakeholders and cross-functional collaboration across Novonesis.
* A supportive, international, and collaborative team environment with strong opportunities for learning and development.

jobs.title: Student til uddannelsespolitik
jobs.location: DI København - Industriens Hus H. C. Andersens Blvd. 18 1553 København Denmark DI København - Industriens Hus H. C. Andersens Blvd. 18 1553 København Denmark København
jobs.description_md:
Har du flair for data og gode kommunikationsevner, og vil du være med til at researche, udarbejde og formidle analyser inden for uddannelsespolitik? Hvis du har interesse for uddannelsespolitik og dansk erhvervsliv og lyst til at blive en del af et ambitiøst og engageret team, så søger DI en student.

**Hvem er vi?**

Du bliver en del af DI’s enhed for Erhvervs- og arbejdsmarkedsuddannelser, hvor vi beskæftiger os med uddannelsespolitik knyttet til erhvervsuddannelser, de gymnasiale uddannelser og arbejdsmarkedsuddannelser m.fl. Vi arbejder for, at virksomhederne kan få opkvalificeret og uddannet deres nuværende og fremtidige medarbejdere via et velfungerende uddannelsessystem.

**Dine opgaver**

Vi søger en student, der kan bistå os med opgaver i samarbejde med vores to andre studenter og enhedens konsulenter. Her er eksempler på nogle af dine arbejdsopgaver:

· Datatræk via offentlige registre og forskeradgang

· Skrive analyse og hjælpe med præsentationer

· Overvågning af udviklingen på uddannelsesområdet

· Hjælpe med forberedelse af møder og oplæg

· Derudover kan du også blive koblet til længerevarende projekter, der er med til at understøtte DI’s langsigtede indsatser på uddannelsesområdet

**Om dig**

· Du er detaljeorienteret og fanger fejl

· Du er analytisk, struktureret og tryg ved Excel samt har kendskab til statistiksoftware

· Du har en interesse for at arbejde med politiske dagsordner

· Du trives med at veksle mellem faglige og praktiske opgaver

· Du har flair for formidling

Vi forestiller os, at du er i gang med en samfundsvidenskabelig uddannelse fx sociologi, økonomi eller samfundsvidenskab – men andre studieretninger er også relevante, hvis du kan sætte flueben ved ovenstående.

Vi har en uformel tone i enheden og løser ofte opgaver i tæt samarbejde med hinanden og med kollegaer fra andre afdelinger. I DI har vi et stærkt forankret studentermiljø med over 100 studentermedhjælpere på tværs i DI og med mange sociale aktiviteter, som du kan blive en del af.

Arbejdstiden tilrettelægges fleksibelt under hensyntagen til dit studie og udgør i gennemsnit 15 timer om ugen.

Vi bor i Industriens Hus på Rådhuspladsen i København.

**Interesseret?**

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, kan du kontakte chefkonsulent Mette Louise Pedersen på [melp@di.dk](mailto:mahf@di.dk) eller tlf +45 2329 0151. Ansøgning kan ske via ansøgningslinket senest 1. oktober. Vi forventer at afholde samtaler i uge 43 og 44.

Tiltrædelse: 1. november eller 1. december

Bemærk, at vi ikke modtager ansøgninger pr. mail.

jobs.title: Digital Technology Student Worker - Data Science
jobs.description_md:
**Job Description**

Just imagine helping decide which LEGO® sets appear on shelves for different customers around the world. Then make it real.

**About the role**

As our Data Science Student Worker, you'll support the team behind the next version of our stock keeping unit (SKU) performance scoring system, run experiments to improve novelty predictions, and help evolve assortment optimization tools. You'll work alongside experienced data scientists on real production pipelines, contributing to data preparation, experimentation, analysis, and production code. It's a hands-on role designed to help you learn while making a meaningful contribution from week one.

**Required Qualifications**

* Solid Python fundamentals

* Good understanding of data analysis and machine learning concepts, e.g. from coursework or other experience

* Comfortable with SQL and working with tabular data

* Fluent English

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to optimization / operations research (e.g. linear programming)

* Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Databricks, AWS)

* Experience with pyspark

**What you'll build**

* Support the development of the next generation of SKU performance scoring capabilities

* Run experiments that improve prediction models and generate actionable insights

* Contribute to assortment optimisation tools used by hundreds of users every day

* Help maintain and improve production data science solutions

* Work with experienced team members to turn analysis into practical outcomes

If you've worked in a role where you used real data to answer business questions, you'll feel at home here. What matters most is your ability to learn, contribute to shared code, and translate analysis into meaningful improvements.

**Life on the team**

You'll join the Assortment & Space Management team within Digital Technology. We help deliver customer- and channel-specific assortment recommendations while creating greater portfolio transparency across the business. Our team works in a hybrid rhythm with daily stand-ups and weekly team sessions, including anchor days on Tuesdays and Thursdays. You'll work closely with data scientists and software engineers while bringing curiosity, reliability, and a strong team spirit to everything you do.

**What success looks like**

Success means confidently contributing to production systems, running experiments that improve model performance, and becoming a trusted member of the team. Over the next 12 to 18 months, we're focused on rolling out a new version of our core product performance scoring and prediction system. You'll work closely with data scientists and software engineers to help shape that journey while building skills that can grow with you at the LEGO Group.

**We're looking for students who**

* Are currently enrolled in Denmark in a **Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Erhvervsakademi** (professional academy) program in fields related to data.

* Preferably graduating summer 2028 or beyond, having at least 1.5-2 years left of studies

* Are curious and willing to learn, with a **positive, team-player attitude**.

jobs.title: Join Halfspace’s Strategy & Execution Team: Associate Engagement Manager (Part-Time, Student Position)
jobs.description_md:
At Halfspace, part of Faculty, we help organisations use artificial intelligence to make better, more informed decisions, faster. We began by predicting outcomes in live football matches and have since delivered more than one hundred AI and data projects across industries, earning international recognition for our work.

What truly defines us is our people. Builders and practitioners who learn fast, challenge each other kindly, and bring genuine curiosity about hard problems. Our team brings together expertise across physics, engineering, mathematics, statistics, operations research, computer science, chemistry, economics, biology, design, and strategy. Halfspace is focused on deep expertise in applied AI. We describe our approach as "inch wide, mile deep".

As an Associate Engagement Manager (part-time) in our Strategy and Execution team, you will sit close to live consulting work and learn how AI strategy actually gets done. This is a student position, designed to fit alongside a bachelor’s or master’s degree, and the role is built around supporting project teams on real client engagements: research, structured analysis, slide work, and the kind of synthesis that helps senior consultants make sharper recommendations. You are here to learn the craft alongside people who do it every day.

Day to day, the work shifts as projects move. One week, it might be a piece of desk research on how a sector is adopting AI. The next, building a deck for client discussion on building a MVPs within their infrastructure. Joining client workshops to see how AI conversations land at the executive level is part of the picture too. Studies come first; the role is designed to flex around exam periods and deadlines.

You will work alongside consultants, engineers, scientists, and strategists, contributing to the same projects but at a scope that fits part-time hours. We value depth, flexibility, trust, and balance. We build a space where curious, thoughtful people can grow while working on projects that matter, alongside some of the world’s most interesting companies.

**Qualifications**

* Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s program in the intersection between tech and business. We are not looking for a specific degree, but example studies could be industrial engineering (cand.polyt), digital business (cand.merc), information system (cand.merc), Design & innovation (cand.polyt), Digital innovation and mgmt. (cand.IT).

* A desire to “translate” between business and tech based on a technical foundation with business flair to solve problems with AI

* Curious about both AI and consulting and drawn to a role where you sit close to real client work across different industries.

* Strong analytical skillset with the ability to structure data, client interviews, SME input, and frameworks into something useful.

* Clear written and verbal communication, across technical and non-technical audiences.

* Comfort with the consulting toolkit (slides, structured documents, basic data work), or the willingness to pick these up quickly.

* Reliable and self-directed incl. managing your own hours, flag when something is unclear, and asking for help when you need it.

* A collaborative default: you lift the people around you and create success within the team instead of focusing on individual performance.

We know that excellent candidates often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement listed. Please apply if you believe you can contribute to this role, even if your background does not match every item above. We would rather see your application than miss you.

**Compensation and Working Arrangements**

This is an Associate Engagement Manager (part-time) position, designed for current students. Expect around 15 to 20 hours per week alongside your studies, with flexibility to scale down during exam periods. We offer a competitive student worker rate, a learning and development budget, and the chance to work on real client engagements from your first week. This is a Copenhagen-based role with preference of people coming to the office. But we want people to bring their whole self, hence we cater for flexibility around your studies and life outside work.

**Life at Halfspace**

We value flexibility, trust, and balance. We invest in learning and development, and we create an environment where people can grow while working on projects that matter. Our clients include some of the world's leading companies, and the work is demanding, but we protect the conditions that make sustained good work possible.

**Location**

Copenhagen.

**About Accenture**

Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities.

jobs.title: Student Worker - Technical Operations
jobs.description_md:
**Job Description**

As a Tech Ops Student Worker, you will play a crucial role in maintaining, tracking, and optimizing hardware and software resources across LEGO Game.

  

You will ensure that all teams have the necessary tools, access, and infrastructure to work efficiently.

  

**Core Responsibilities** 

* Assist with day-to-day operations within the respective department and team
* Support team members on ongoing projects by conducting research, data analysis, and compiling reports
* Participate in team meetings and contribute ideas for improvement
* Help create and maintain documentation for processes and procedures
* Collaborate with other interns and staff to complete assigned tasks and projects
* Perform administrative tasks as needed to support team objectives

  

* *Maintaining, cataloging, and documenting hardware and software used across LEGO Game teams.*

* *Ensuring all team members have access to the platforms, tools, and environments they need.*

* *Setting up and managing software licenses, permissions, and configurations.*

* *Liaising with internal IT teams to facilitate smooth operations and resolve technical issues.*

* *Monitoring and improving development workflows, deployment processes, and system performance.*

* *Assisting in automating and optimizing infrastructure and development environments.*

* *Supporting onboarding processes by ensuring new employees have the necessary tools and access.*

* *Keeping track of emerging technologies and best practices to improve efficiency and security.*

## 

## Play your part in our team succeeding

  

*LEGO Game is growing rapidbly, expanding teams and team members as well as our portfolio of hard-software and infrastructure.* 

  

*You will be the fountain of knowledge and the clutch power that ensures we all aim for a uniform approach across the department.* 

  

**Do you have what it takes?** 

*A student of Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).* 

  

* Basic knowledge of DevOps practices, IT administration, or system management.

* Familiarity with cloud platforms is a plus.

* Some experience with scripting is beneficial but not required.

* A structured and detail-oriented mindset for tracking and managing software and hardware resources.

* Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to troubleshooting.

  

* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with IT and game development teams.

* A passion for gaming and an interest in the gaming industry is a bonus!

* Knowledge of Atlassian Software, JIRA/CONFLUENCE
* *Danish and English at C1-C2 levels*

  

**Join the global LEGO family** 

The LEGO® Group recruits and develops people entirely on merit.  If you are confident you have what it takes to succeed in this role – and you share our commitment to creativity, collaboration, and quality – use the APPLY NOW button above or below.  Please remember to attach your application and current CV. 

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

**What’s in it for you?**

Here is what you can expect:

**Family Care Leave** - We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times.

**Insurances** – All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind.

**Wellbeing** - We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity.

**Colleague Discount** – We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount.

**Bonus** - We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme.

**Workplace** - When you join the team you'll be assigned a primary workplace location i.e. one of our Offices, stores or factories. Our hybrid work policy means an average of 3 days per week in the office. The hiring team will discuss the policy and role eligibility with you during the recruitment process.

Children are our role models. Their curiosity, creativity and imagination inspire everything we do. We strive to create a diverse, dynamic and inclusive culture of play at the LEGO Group, where everyone feels safe, valued and they belong.

The LEGO Group is highly committed to equal employment opportunity and equal pay and seeks to encourage applicants from all backgrounds (eg. sex, gender identity or expression, race/ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, age and religion) to apply for roles in our team.

The LEGO Group is fully committed to Children’s Rights and Child Wellbeing across the globe. Candidates offered positions with high engagement with children are required to take part in Child Safeguarding Background Screening, as a condition of the offer.

Thank you for sharing our global commitment to Children’s Rights.

Just imagine building your dream career.

Then make it real.

**Join the LEGO® team today.**

jobs.title: Student Assistant - Communication and Marketing in Aarhus
jobs.description_md:
*Vi søger en studentermedhjælper til vores revisionsafdeling i Aarhus, som kan bidrage til vores interne og eksterne kommunikation igennem bl.a. LinkedIn, nyhedsmails og andre spændende projekter.*

**Din rolle**

Som studentermedhjælper bliver du en vigtig del af vores lokale vækst- og markedsføringsindsats i Aarhus. Du kommer til at arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem kommunikation, marketing og business development såvel internt som eksternt, hvor du bidrager til at øge KPMG's synlighed i markedet og understøtte vores relationer til eksisterende og potentielle kunder.

Du får en bred kontaktflade til partnere, revisorer og vores centrale marketingfunktion og bliver involveret i alt fra LinkedIn-kommunikation, events og tilbudsprocesser til kampagner, markedsanalyser og go-to-market aktiviteter.

Dine kerneopgaver vil bestå af at:

* Planlægge, koordinere og eksekvere kommunikations- og marketingaktiviteter på tværs af relevante kanaler, herunder LinkedIn. Dette omfatter udarbejdelse af opslag baseret på faglige artikler, kundecases og arrangementer samt analyse af rækkevidde, engagement og relevante branchetrends inden for revision, skat, CFO-agendaen og AI.
* Bidrage til udvikling af kommunikations- og marketingmateriale, herunder salgsoplæg, tilbudsmateriale og andet skriftligt og visuelt indhold.
* Understøtte planlægning, markedsføring og afvikling af events og netværksaktiviteter samt rekruttering af deltagere til CFO-netværk og faglige arrangementer.
* Følge op på leads og mødeaktiviteter i forbindelse med afholdte events og netværksaktiviteter.
* Bidrage til den daglige drift af kommunikationsindsatsen og understøtte den lokale kommunikationsstrategi i samarbejde med vores centrale marketingfunktion i København.
* Koordinere samarbejdet med eksterne leverandører, herunder fotografer, og sikre løbende opdatering af billedmateriale til ekstern kommunikation.
* Bidrage til anvendelsen af AI-værktøjer i både intern og ekstern kommunikation, herunder optimering af markedsføringsindhold og udvikling af nye digitale initiativer.
* Arbejde med nyhedsbreve, e-mail marketing samt data og indsigter med henblik på løbende optimering af kommunikations- og marketingindsatser.

Hos KPMG Aarhus bliver du en del af et lokalt revisionshus med globale rødder, hvor mulighederne er mange. Foruden et højt fagligt niveau og et højt engagement blandt kollegaer, vil du opleve, at sociale relationer og kollegialt samspil står os nært.

**Om dig, vores nye kollega**

* Du er under uddannelse inden for kommunikation, journalistik, markedsføring eller lignende. Vi forventer, at du er på kandidatniveau eller i gang med at færdiggøre din bachelor.
* Vi forestiller os, at du har en stor interesse for B2B-markedsføring og professionel rådgivning samt en god forståelse for, hvordan virksomheder arbejder med kommunikation, synlighed og relationer.
* Du er god til digitale platforme og sociale medier og motiveres af at omsætte idéer til konkrete aktiviteter. Samtidig arbejder du struktureret og er god til koordinering og projektstyring, så opgaver bliver fulgt til dørs.
* Du er nysgerrig på AI og nye teknologier samt interesserer dig for kommercielle aktiviteter og forretningsudvikling. Det vigtigste er dog, at du er initiativrig, åben for nye opgaver og har lyst til at bidrage til vores lokale vækst- og markedsføringsarbejde i Aarhus.
* Du er sprogligt dygtig og formår at skrive klart, professionelt og grammatisk korrekt på både dansk og engelsk.
* Derudover er du motiveret, kvalitetsbevidst og omhyggelig. Du stiller store krav til dig selv og dit arbejde. Du kan arbejde selvstændigt og komme i mål inden for til tider korte deadlines. Vi vil gerne have, at du er motiveret for personlig og faglig udvikling og har lyst til at sætte dit eget præg på jobbeskrivelsen.

**Vi tilbyder**

Den gennemsnitlige arbejdstid er ca. 15 timer om ugen, hvilket giver dig mulighed for at kombinere dit studie med relevant erhvervserfaring og udvikling af dine kompetencer. Vi er selvfølgelig fleksible i eksamensperioder.

Hos KPMG har vi fokus på det hele menneske. Du vil få rige muligheder for at udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt. Vi arbejder i teams og på tværs af niveau, så der vil altid være nogen at spørge og lære af. Du bliver del af en international arbejdsplads med åbne døre og unge, motiverede kollegaer. Vi taler sammen og lytter til hinanden, fordi vi stoler på vores kollegaer, og fordi vi har indset, at gode løsninger ofte opstår på baggrund af mere end ét perspektiv.

**Kontakt og ansøgning**

Vi vil gerne høre fra dig, så du er mere end velkommen til at kontakte Rafi Rahimzai på [rrahimzai@kpmg.com](mailto:rrahimzai@kpmg.com) for at høre mere.

Lyder jobbet som noget for dig, tøv ikke med at søge. For at gøre processen så nem som mulig for dig, kræver vi blot upload af dit CV sammen med dine seneste karakterer (bachelor og kandidat). Vi indkalder kandidater løbende til samtale og lukker opslaget, når vi har fundet den rigtige.

Vi opfordrer alle interesserede uanset alder, køn, handicap, race, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold til at søge stillingen.

Vi ser frem til at få dig ombord.

jobs.title: Trafikvært (barselsvikariat)
jobs.description_md:
Kunne du tænke dig at hjælpe pendlerne sikkert frem på de danske veje? DR København søger en barselsvikar i rollen som trafikvært. Jobbet er for dig, der elsker hurtig formidling både på Danmarks største radiokanal - P4 - trafiksitet på dr.dk og TVA.

**Om jobbet**

P4 Trafik har i alt tre trafikcentre: Et i København, et i Odense og et i Aarhus. Under de regionale morgen- og eftermiddagsflader på P4 sender alle centrene trafikmeldinger fra deres område. Uden for myldretiden i hverdagene og hele weekenden bliver trafikmeldingerne over hele landet sendt fra centret i Trafiktårnet i København. Dine vagter bliver hovedsageligt – men ikke udelukkende – kl. 05-11 eller 12-18 på hverdage.

Som trafikvært hos DR København vil du komme til at arbejde i Trafiktårnet i København, centralt placeret ved Dybbølsbro. Her vil du sidde tæt på medarbejderne i Vejdirektoratets Trafikcenter og i samarbejde med dem og de andre trafikværter sikre, at præcise trafikmeldinger sendes ud i hovedstadsområdet og resten af Danmark.

**Din profil**

* Du kan lide hurtig formidling på radio, tv og web
* Du er god til at holde overblik, selv når der er travlt
* Du er god til at samarbejde med andre – internt som eksternt
* Du er en god kollega
* Du er god til at kommunikere effektivt og professionelt både mundtligt og på skrift
* Du har en troværdig og myndig stemme, der evner at signalere overblik uanset travlhed
* Du har med fordel god geografisk forståelse og et kørekort
* Du har med fordel erfaring med radiomediet

**Vi tilbyder**

En tidsbegrænset stilling på 33 timer som barselsvikar fra december til juli måned.

Vi tilbyder et gennemgribende oplæringsforløb, så du føler dig godt rustet.

Trafikredaktionen hos DR København er en stærk og selvkørende redaktion, hvor der er et godt sammenhold. Vi er i konstant udvikling og ikke én dag er ens. Der kan både være fart over feltet og mere stille timer, hvor der er rum til sparring og faglige diskussioner. Der er 5 fast tilknyttede trafikværter i Trafiktårnet og et større hold studentermedhjælpere. Vi sigter mod at besætte stillingen fra 1. december.

**Kontakt**

DR ønsker at afspejle samfundet. Derfor opfordrer vi alle uanset køn, alder, religion, handicap og etnisk baggrund til at søge.

Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen så kontakt redaktionschef Morten Møbjerg på [mmz@dr.dk](mailto:mmz@dr.dk) eller trafikvært Mads Herholdt (kl. 10:30-18:00) på telefon 3520 6844.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning, dit cv og relevante eksamenspapirer. Stillinger i DR søges udelukkende elektronisk. Du søger ved at klikke på ”Søg stillingen” i højre side.

Ansøgningsfristen er søndag den 27. september og vi forventer at holde ansættelsessamtaler i uge 43.
